name: agentic/contact-form
title: Contact Form
description: Two-column "Get in touch" panel: a location photo (with an optional name/address caption overlaid bottom-left) on one side, a name/email/phone/message form on the other. Leave `action` empty to store submissions in-house and email the admin (see agentic-blocks/inc/form-entries.php), same convention as newsletter-signup; point it at a real inbox/service endpoint to bypass that. `imageUrlMobile` is optional — a smaller derivative of `imageUrl` served via `srcset` below the block's 780px breakpoint, since this photo is usually the page's LCP element and this block has no automatic WordPress srcset (a static theme asset, not a media-library attachment) to size it down on its own; omit it and the block renders exactly as before, one file at every width.
